description: Ask the project's memory before acting. Evaluates intent against durable invariants and conventions. Zero conversation retention: query text is strictly ephemeral and never stored. Pass the recallId to 'report' so task outcomes sharpen what was recalled.

intent.description: What you are trying to do or know, in plain words

limit.description: How many matched statements to serve (default 5, max 20)

tags.description: Optional tags to filter or guide lexical matching

type.description: Optional statement type filter: directive, fact, preference, or observation

name: recall
